inventory_levels_nonneg.name: inventory_levels_nonneg
inventory_levels_nonneg.value: "inventory_levels"."reserved" >= 0 and "inventory_levels"."incoming" >= 0 and ("inventory_levels"."reorder_point" is null or "inventory_levels"."reorder_point" >= 0) and ("inventory_levels"."safety_stock" is null or "inventory_levels"."safety_stock" >= 0)

inventory_movements_ref_uq.name: inventory_movements_ref_uq
inventory_movements_ref_uq.where: "inventory_movements"."ref_id" is not null and "inventory_movements"."ref_type" is not null

locations_shopify_ids.name: locations_shopify_ids
locations_shopify_ids.value: "locations"."source" <> 'shopify' or ("locations"."store_connection_id" is not null and "locations"."external_id" is not null)
